Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer incorrectly identified the headquarters city of the Southeastern Conference (SEC) as "Jackson, Mississippi" based on the search results. The actual headquarters of the SEC is in Birmingham, Alabama. This initial error led to a chain of redundant and ineffective search attempts by the Planner to verify conflicting information, as the WebSurfer failed to extract the correct location from the visible search results (which included a snippet from SECU showing the Birmingham address) or to pivot to a more reliable source like Wikipedia or the official SEC site immediately.
